content.short: Chainjet is a decentralized platform for automating on-chain and off-chain tasks.
content.description: Chainjet provides a broad and well-structured library of automation modules for web3 protocols, dapps, and developer tools. Users can deploy these modules to streamline repetitive tasks and workflows, saving time and effort. Developers can build their own modules and contribute them to the collection for other users to reuse. Chainjet supports eight blockchains and integrates with hundreds of popular dapps and web3 protocols, enabling scalable automations across multiple ecosystems and use cases.
content.meta: Chainjet enables building on-chain or off-chain task automations. Discover Chainjet and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
